summary: Fase 3 (Minhas Regras / banned_patterns) end-to-end verified. Backend: 18/18 pytest tests pass (auth, CRUD, invalid tipo=400, scope filter global vs project, import multi-line, export text/plain, RLS boundary user B blocked, and — critically — analyze_chapter integration for tipo=frase (ai_fingerprint), tipo=gesto (gesture_cooldown with custom cooldown_max flagging only excess), tipo=descritor (descriptor_cooldown), plus regression that 8-check pipeline still fires when zero custom rules are present). Frontend: full RulesPage CRUD verified via Playwright — scope tabs (project/global), type-select conditional cooldown field (visible for gesto+descritor, hidden for frase+estrutura), create / import multi-line (3 lines paste creates 3 rules) / export .txt download (file contains all rule texts) / delete rule (removes from list). CRITICAL INTEGRATION UI-driven: created chapter with 2× 'o coração dela disparou' + save+analyze via confirm modal → analysis result page shows 'Regra personalizada disparada' suggestion referencing target phrase → returned to Rules page → 'triggered' counter for that rule advanced from 1x to 3x (delta = 2, matching 2 occurrences). Regression: existing Fase 1+2 15/15 tests still green; wallet still shows 5 credits after analysis (checks 1-8 free, credits_consumidos=0). No blocking issues.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/rules.py:14-27 — list_banned_patterns has no cross-user leak, but the default (no project_id) returns only global rules. This is intentional per the spec but could confuse users viewing all rules at once. Consider adding a 'scope=all' option later.

routers/rules.py:70-90 — import endpoint has no MAX_LINES cap; malicious/accidental paste of thousands of lines would each hit a separate INSERT inside a single transaction. Bound recommended (e.g., 500).
routers/analysis.py:71-75 — disparos_count update is inside the same transaction as analysis_run insert (good, atomic). No optimistic concurrency issues observed.

checks/*.py — case-insensitive re.escape matching used consistently across ai_fingerprint/gesture_cooldown/descriptor_cooldown for custom_patterns; overlapping matches (e.g. rule 'apertou' inside 'apertou os punhos') would double-count when both exist as separate rules, but this is expected (each rule is independent).
frontend RulesPage.jsx:38-92 — no confirm() before delete; single click on trash immediately deletes the rule. Consider a lightweight confirmation for accidental deletes.
frontend RulesPage.jsx:89-92 — handleDelete lacks try/catch; if API fails, list is not reloaded and no toast shown.
